title: Decree on Climate Change No. 321/GOV (2019)
citation: Decree of the Government of Lao PDR No. 321/GOV (321/ລບ) on Climate Change, Vientiane, 18 September 2019; entered on the Official Gazette on 2019-10-17 (Gazette id 1544)
evidence: Art. 50: "ດໍາລັດສະບັບນີ້ ມີຜົນສັກສິດພາຍຫຼັງໄດ້ລົງລາຍເຊັນ ແລະ ໄດ້ລົງຈົດໝາຍເຫດທາງລັດຖະການ ສິບຫ້າ ວັນ" (the decree takes effect fifteen days after signature and entry on the Official Gazette). The Gazette page https://laoofficialgazette.gov.la/index.php?r=site/display&id=1544 lists the decree date 18-09-2019 and the Gazette date 17-10-2019; 17 October 2019 plus fifteen days is 2019-11-01. The Gazette states no commencement date, so 2019-11-01 is computed. Page image of the last page opened on 2026-11-03.
notes: Number and date confirmed on the Gazette: Decree No. 321/GOV, 18 September 2019 (the existing register row had the number only in the file name). Duties fall on ministries, local authorities and project owners in climate change work; no company emissions reporting duty was read, so duty_on stays state_only. The decree cites the Law on Environmental Protection of 2012 as No. 041/NA; the 2024 amended law cites the same 2012 law as No. 29/NA. Language: Lao, the only official language of legislation; the Gazette page offers no English download, and its help page says the instruments on the Gazette have no English version. title: Decree on Carbon Credits No. 292/GOV

title: Law on Environmental Protection (amended) No. 53/NA
citation: Law on Environmental Protection (amended) No. 53/NA of 28 June 2024, promulgated by Decree of the President No. 119/PO of 12 August 2024; entered on the Official Gazette on 2024-12-16 (Gazette id 2312)
evidence: Art. 102: "ກົດໝາຍສະບັບນີ້ ມີຜົນສັກສິດ ນັບແຕ່ວັນທີ 1 ກັນຍາ 2024 ພາຍຫຼັງ ປະທານປະເທດ ... ອອກລັດຖະດໍາລັດປະກາດໃຊ້ ແລະ ໄດ້ລົງຈົດໝາຍເຫດທາງລັດຖະການ ເປັນຕົ້ນໄປ" (the law takes effect from 1 September 2024, after the President issues the promulgating decree and it is entered on the Official Gazette). Page image opened on 2026-11-03. The promulgating Decree of the President No. 119/PO is dated 12 August 2024 and takes effect from signature; the Gazette page https://laoofficialgazette.gov.la/index.php?r=site/display&id=2312 lists law date 28-06-2024 and Gazette date 16-12-2024.
notes: The brief named the 2012 act (No. 29/NA). The Gazette serves only the amended law, No. 53/NA of 28 June 2024, whose Art. 102 replaces the Law on Environmental Protection No. 29/NA of 18 December 2012 (and Art. 2 of the 2020 amending law No. 84/NA); a Gazette title search for the 2012 law found nothing, so the 2012 text is not stored and the record starts at 2024-09-01. The in-force date is the one printed in Art. 102; the Gazette entry is dated 16 December 2024, later than that date, so whether the law bound before its Gazette entry is not settled by the page. Implemented by la-decree-eia-389. Language: Lao only; no English download on the Gazette page. title: Law on Consumer Protection No. 02/NA
citation: Law on Consumer Protection No. 02/NA of 30 June 2010 (National Assembly resolution No. 59/NA), promulgated by Decree of the President No. 160/PO of 20 July 2010; entered on the Official Gazette on 2014-02-18 (Gazette id 545)
evidence: Art. 74: "ກົດໝາຍສະບັບນີ້ ມີຜົນສັກສິດ ພາຍຫຼັງເກົ້າສິບວັນ ນັບແຕ່ວັນ ປະທານປະເທດ ... ອອກລັດຖະດໍາລັດປະກາດໃຊ້" (the law takes effect ninety days after the President issues the promulgating decree). The promulgating Decree of the President No. 160/PO on the first page of the PDF carries the handwritten date 20-7-2010 (page image opened on 2026-11-03); 20 July 2010 plus ninety days is 2010-10-18. The Gazette page https://laoofficialgazette.gov.la/index.php?r=site/display&id=545 lists law date 30-06-2010 and Gazette date 18-02-2014 and states no commencement date, so 2010-10-18 is computed.
notes: Umbrella law for consumer protection, including misleading claims about goods and services; it has no environmental-claims provision that was searched for by name, so it is F6 only as the general legal base. The Gazette serves one English PDF ('Law on Consumer Protection.pdf', 26 pages with a text layer) next to the Lao scan. The Gazette's own home page says English texts on the Gazette are unofficial translations, so under LA-GAZETTE-TRANSLATION (permission requested) it is not stored. The Ministry of Industry and Commerce agreement on the content of advertising of goods (dated 2025-02-20, Gazette id 2337) implements the law; its OCR text has no occurrence of the Lao word for environment, so it is not in scope. title: Guideline on the Issuance of Green, Social and Sustainability Bonds No. 06/LSC
citation: Guideline of the Lao Securities Commission No. 06/LSC on the Issuance of Green, Social and Sustainability Bonds, Vientiane, 20 August 2024 (listed on https://www.lsc.gov.la/legislation/guideline.php?page=1)
evidence: Art. 16: "ຄໍາແນະນໍາສະບັບນີ້ ມີຜົນສັກສິດ ນັບແຕ່ວັນລົງລາຍເຊັນ ເປັນຕົ້ນໄປ" (the guideline takes effect from signature); page 1 of the PDF is dated 20 August 2024 (image opened on 2026-11-03), the same date as the listing on https://www.lsc.gov.la/legislation/guideline.php?page=1.
notes: The brief asked whether the Lao Securities Commission has an ESG disclosure rule for listed companies. None was found: the 160 rows on the first three pages of each LSC legislation list (laws, resolutions, ordinances, decrees, orders, agreements, guidelines, notifications, regulations) were searched for the Lao words for green, sustainable, environment, climate, carbon, ESG, ASEAN, governance, disclosure and report; the general agreement on reporting and disclosure of the securities market (No. 29/LSC of 2022) has no ESG wording in its title and was not read; the only sustainability instruments are this guideline and a fee-waiver notice for such bonds (Notice No. 09/LSC of 2025-09-12). This guideline implements the bond issuance agreement No. 20/LSC of 2021 for green, social and sustainability bonds and requires issuers to disclose use of proceeds and an external review certificate on their website (Art. 13 and 14). The Gazette does not carry it; the LSC hosts it as a scanned PDF (the page link readpdf.php?id=152 returns a JavaScript redirect to the Doc_legal path). The LSC site has no terms page; the row passes on Law on Intellectual Property No. 50/NA Art. 93(3), which excludes legal instruments from copyright. Language: Lao only; no English text on the LSC site was found.
